About Chandra Bhakta Adhikari

I build relationships that move people from first interest to real commitment. Five plus years bridging youth, colleges, NGOs, government and business across Nepal, leading participants through a full engagement funnel: outreach, motivation building, event conversion and follow through. That includes direct training and cultivation of 5,000+ youth across 10+ districts. I started in geology, mapping ground and reading rock, and that same habit of showing up in person carried straight into program management, stakeholder reporting and event delivery.

  • Location: Bhaktapur, Nepal
  • Education: B.Sc. Geology, Tribhuvan University
  • Languages: Nepali, English, Hindi
  • Birthplace: Phidim, Panchthar
  • Also written as: Chandra Adhikari, Bhakta Adhikari, Chandra Bhakta, Chandra B. Adhikari, C. B. Adhikari, C.B. Adhikari, C B Adhikari, Chandra B Adhikari

Frequently asked questions

Who is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari?

Chandra Bhakta Adhikari is a Nepal-based Program Manager and Strategic Partnerships professional working across youth leadership, entrepreneurship, stakeholder engagement and community development. He has 5+ years of experience with NGOs, government and business, is based in Bhaktapur, and is a geologist by training (B.Sc., Tribhuvan University).

What is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari's current role?

He is Program Manager at Nepal Business Institute, where he leads planning and execution of national business and youth-entrepreneurship summits such as the Nepal Business Summit. He joined the institute as Program Officer in October 2024. He also serves as Project Coordinator at Asha Project Nepal and as a training consultant with Connection Nepal.

What is the Nepal Business Summit and what does he do there?

The Nepal Business Summit is a national program run by Nepal Business Institute that brings together ministries, sponsors, media and entrepreneurs. Chandra coordinated the 2025 Nepal Business Summit and Nepal Youth Entrepreneurship Summit as Program Officer, and now leads the program as Program Manager, covering strategy, budget, sponsorship, government liaison, stall allocation and media.

What training does Chandra Bhakta Adhikari deliver?

Since 2019 he has been a trainer and consultant with Connection Nepal, delivering Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation, Menstrual Hygiene Management (MHM) and WASH training. He has trained 5,000+ youth, educators and community members, including in rural municipalities such as Baitadi, Rautahat, Sindhupalchok and Mahottari.

What is his role in Rotaract District 3292?

Chandra served as District Secretary of Rotaract District 3292 (Nepal & Bhutan) for 2025–26, handling communication, governance and records for 150+ clubs. Since 2019 he has progressed through SAP Coordinator, Club President, Immediate Past President, Sergeant-at-Arms, Assistant District Secretary and Assistant District Rotaract Representative, and is Adviser to the Rotaract Club of Sukedhara.

What does Asha Project Nepal do, and what is his part in it?

Chandra has been Project Coordinator at Asha Project Nepal since January 2019, overseeing education, sanitation and community-development activities across 18 districts and 29 schools. His work includes coordinating with district teams and local NGOs, donor reporting and monitoring & evaluation. He is also the organization's Goodwill Ambassador.

Where is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari based, and what is his educational background?

He is based in Bhaktapur, Nepal, and was born in Phidim, Panchthar. He holds a B.Sc. in Geology from Tribhuvan University, with field experience in GIS, mapping, ERT and SRT surveys. He speaks Nepali, English and Hindi.

What certifications does he hold?

He holds 21 professional certifications earned between January and June 2025, covering project management, event management, leadership, public speaking, HR strategy, GIS, internet marketing and cloud fundamentals. They were issued by Udemy, MTF Institute, Oxford Home Study Center, eLearning College and Simplilearn, and each is listed with its credential ID on the Experience page.

Has Chandra Bhakta Adhikari received any awards?

Yes. He received Outstanding Rotaract Project (2019–20) and Outstanding Rotaract District Member (2022–23 and 2023–24), both from Rotary International District 3292.

Is he available for speaking, training or partnerships?

Yes. He is open to speaking invitations, training requests and strategic partnerships, including keynotes, panels and facilitation on youth leadership, entrepreneurship, MHM/WASH and disaster risk reduction. Reach him at hello@adhikarichandra.com.np or through the Contact page.

What does Chandra Adhikari do?

Chandra Adhikari (Chandra Bhakta Adhikari) is a Program Manager and Strategic Partnerships professional in Nepal. He plans and delivers national youth-entrepreneurship programs at Nepal Business Institute, builds partnerships with colleges, NGOs, sponsors and government stakeholders, and trains communities in MHM, WASH and Disaster Risk Reduction.

What is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari known for?

He is known in Nepal for organizing national business and youth-entrepreneurship summits, for leadership in Rotaract District 3292 (Nepal & Bhutan, 150+ clubs), and for MHM, WASH and Disaster Risk Reduction training that has reached 5,000+ youth, educators and community members.

Where does Chandra Bhakta Adhikari work?

He works as Program Manager at Nepal Business Institute (NBI), as Project Coordinator at The Asha Project Nepal, and as a Trainer (Consultant) with Connection Nepal. He is based in Bhaktapur, in the Kathmandu Valley, Nepal.

What is Chandra Adhikari's role at NBI and in NYES?

NBI is Nepal Business Institute and NYES is the Nepal Youth Entrepreneurship Summit. Chandra coordinated the 2025 Nepal Business Summit and the 2025 NYES as Program Officer, and now leads planning and delivery of NBI's national youth-entrepreneurship programs as Program Manager, including sponsorship, government liaison, media and stakeholder coordination.

What organizations is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari associated with?

Nepal Business Institute (Program Manager), The Asha Project Nepal (Project Coordinator and Goodwill Ambassador), Connection Nepal (Trainer and Consultant), Rotaract District 3292 (District Secretary 2025–26), the Rotaract Club of Sukedhara (Club Adviser), the T.U. SEG Student Chapter (Member) and, formerly, Amnesty International's Tri-Chandra Youth Network.

What are Chandra Adhikari's professional interests?

His professional interests are youth leadership, entrepreneurship development, strategic partnerships, stakeholder engagement, event and summit management, community development, Menstrual Hygiene Management, WASH, Disaster Risk Reduction and climate adaptation, and GIS and geology from his academic background.

Is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari on LinkedIn, Instagram or Facebook?

Yes. His profiles are LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/adchandra), Instagram (@c_.b_.a_) and Facebook (facebook.com/adhi.rjn). All three are linked from this website, which is his official portfolio.

Does Chandra Adhikari have a personal website or portfolio?

Yes. adhikarichandra.com.np is the official portfolio of Chandra Bhakta Adhikari. It covers his experience and certifications, a 15-chapter career journey, Rotaract leadership history, a photo gallery and contact details.

Are Chandra Adhikari, Bhakta Adhikari and C.B. Adhikari the same person?

On this website, yes: Chandra Bhakta Adhikari is also written Chandra Adhikari, Bhakta Adhikari, Chandra B. Adhikari and C.B. Adhikari. Adhikari is a common surname in Nepal, so to identify him look for Nepal Business Institute, Rotaract District 3292, Connection Nepal or The Asha Project Nepal, and a base in Bhaktapur.
